entries.text: The valley is a recognised bird sanctuary. Patient watchers have logged more than two hundred species along the same dry-stream paths the children walk to class.

entries.situation: one of ten 'valley facts', random per page load, shown on hover/focus of the sidebar logo
entries.text: There are no bells. Lessons begin and end by a shared sense of time, an idea Krishnamurti held to so that attention was never summoned by a ringing.

entries.situation: one of ten 'valley facts', random per page load, shown on hover/focus of the sidebar logo
entries.text: Three hills frame the school: Bodikonda to the west, Middle Peak in the centre, and Rishikonda to the east, the granite ridge that gives the valley its first light.

entries.situation: one of ten 'valley facts', random per page load, shown on hover/focus of the sidebar logo
entries.text: The great banyan is old enough that its dropped roots have become trunks of their own, so a single tree now shelters whole classes sitting in its shade.

entries.situation: one of ten 'valley facts', random per page load, shown on hover/focus of the sidebar logo
entries.text: Asthachal, the sunset-watching place, is kept in silence. Students gather at dusk to watch the light leave the hills and say nothing at all.

entries.situation: one of ten 'valley facts', random per page load, shown on hover/focus of the sidebar logo
entries.text: The open-air amphitheatre is cut into a slope, so an unamplified voice on the stone floor carries cleanly to the back row.

entries.situation: one of ten 'valley facts', random per page load, shown on hover/focus of the sidebar logo
entries.text: Jiddu Krishnamurti founded the school in 1926 with the wish that learning happen without fear, reward, or comparison between one child and the next.

entries.situation: one of ten 'valley facts', random per page load, shown on hover/focus of the sidebar logo
entries.text: Decades of careful planting turned eroded scrubland back into woodland, and the returning birds were the first sign that the valley had healed.

entries.situation: one of ten 'valley facts', random per page load, shown on hover/focus of the sidebar logo
entries.text: The houses are named for trees and hills of the valley, so a student's first address is also a small lesson in what grows around them.

entries.situation: one of ten 'valley facts', random per page load, shown on hover/focus of the sidebar logo
entries.text: Rain is read, not forecast. Old students still tell which hill the clouds will break over by the way the wind turns through the three peaks.
